newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SASOL PLANT PARTLY SHUT FOR MAINTENANCE.
newsitem.headline: SASOL PLANT PARTLY SHUT FOR MAINTENANCE.

text.p: Sasol Ltd's Secunda synthetic fuels sulphur recovery plant is partly out of operation for maintenance work, the South African fuels group said on Wednesday.
The plant is expected to be back in full operation on Thursday following the completion of the round-the-clock maintenance work.

"The maintenance work... is necessary to ensure that the performance of the plant complies with the permit requirements of the Directorate of Air Pollution Control for safe emission levels for hydrogen sulphide," Sasol said in a statement.
The plant removes hydrogen sulphide from synthesis gas and converts it into solid suplur -- thereby preventing its release into the atmoshere as a pollutant.
